Ontology_AssayAndWorkflow_prompt.notes: The experiment is primarily an AP-MS (interactome) study of EGFR. While it uses LFQ, the search parameters explicitly include phosphorylation and ubiquitination (GlyGly tag), and the PRIDE metadata identifies it as an affinity purification experiment. The 'PTM-enriched' mode is selected because the study specifically targets the EGFR interactome and its post-translational modifications.

Ontology_TreatmentAndDesign_prompt.notes: The proteomics experiment specifically analyzes the EGFR interactome using AP-MS. The primary comparisons are between the ligand (EGF) and the antibody combination (Sym004) against a control IgG background. Sym004 is mapped to small_molecule_inhibitor_treatment as it is a therapeutic antibody acting as an inhibitor/blocker of the receptor, though it is technically a protein; within the provided ontology, this is the most appropriate modality for a therapeutic agent targeting a receptor to inhibit signaling.
